title: Convergence of a single-ensemble multilevel scheme for McKean-Vlasov SDEs
summary: Numerically solving McKean-Vlasov stochastic differential equations is computationally challenging due to the compounding costs of discretizing in time and in the distribution of the solution. Multilevel ideas have been proposed to provide speed-ups. In this work, we study the multilevel Monte Carlo method proposed by Ricketson (2015) for equations whose drift and diffusion terms depend on the law of the solution $X_t$ through the expectation $E[R(X_t)]$.
